General Information.question: What is ECCMon?
General Information.answer: ECCMon is a QR scanning system designed to monitor cylinder covers.

General Information.question: What is ECCMon Mobile?
General Information.answer: ECCMon Mobile is the progressive web app (PWA) version of ECCMon.

General Information.question: What happens after scanning the QR code?
General Information.answer: The app will display detailed information about the cylinder cover.

General Information.question: What are the different types of operations in ECCMon mobile?
General Information.answer: ECCMon mobile tracks Storage, Process, Mounted, Dismounted, and Disposal operations.

Getting Started.question: How do I get started with ECCMon?
Getting Started.answer: Install the PWA, sign in, and start scanning QR codes.

Getting Started.question: How do I scan a cylinder cover's QR code?
Getting Started.answer: Tap Scan QR and point your camera at the QR code.

Operations.question: How do I add a new cylinder cover?
Operations.answer: Scan the QR code or enter the serial number manually.

Operations.question: How do I update an existing cylinder cover?
Operations.answer: Scan the QR code and select the desired operation.

Account & Settings.question: Can I change the language in the app?
Account & Settings.answer: Yes, go to Settings and select your preferred language.

Account & Settings.question: How can I log out of the app?
Account & Settings.answer: Tap the Logout button in the profile section.
